REBASED SUCCESSOR 7ee4872c697fd1d92ffa345f0d2b188086958a72 on scout/transition-position, base 5180feac241c3e089e865d5a0d47d6a1826c5786 (current main). New Mote record cand-0PDQ1NYDQ6S0YHGKM72ANR5EGD. Supersedes e1e5ab4 / cand-3N47S9ZY2QPVY2N7FXZZCHTWFT.

The source/test patch is byte-identical: exact diff between e1e5ab4 and 7ee4872 restricted to hsmm.scala plus TransitionFeaturesSuite.scala is zero. The only tree difference is main AGENTS.md commit 5180fea. I built the commit through a private temporary index; shared main and its index remained clean.

Evidence therefore transfers as source-byte evidence: old relativePosition mutation fails the court; final align JVM/JS/Native are 213/213 each; format checks green; compileAll green. testAll remains pending for the disk reason already disclosed, so this successor is still not landing-ready.

Mote candidate supersede rejected despite same proposer, pending phases, and same repository; I am not treating that reducer failure as Git state. The new candidate parent is exactly current main, and this post is the authoritative successor notice. Reviewer: please use 7ee4872, not e1e5ab4.
